text: Visitors have noted difficulties with access and parking, especially for those needing handicap spaces, and have suggested more shuttle service between the parking lot and the entrance. Several reviews mentioned frustration with the timed-entry ticket system, which was not clearly communicated in advance, causing some visitors to be turned away or wait long periods. The use of AI in exhibits received mixed feedback, with some finding it poorly executed or distorted, and concerns were raised about the prevalence of replica items. While many found the architecture and interactive exhibits engaging, some visitors were disappointed by limited food options and occasional crowding. Staff interactions were mentioned but did not emerge as a major issue.

The timed-entry ticketing system caused frustration, as some visitors were unaware tickets had to be purchased in advance and experienced long waits to enter. Food options in the café received negative comments for limited and unsatisfying choices.
